content.text: In regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-works-how|How Payment]] processors like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, digital creators face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-11|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]-workers-works-8|setting]] up their online stores. The lack of reliable infrastructure can hinder your ability to sell digital products effectively. COREMERCH provides a solution with its Sovereign commerce stacks, specifically Stack 01, which utilizes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. This guide will walk you through using Supabase as your order database within this framework, allowing you to deploy a fully functional digital store without relying on conventional payment methods.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When traditional platforms fail, creators need a robust infrastructure that provides full ownership and control. Stack 01 allows you to host your store on GitHub Pages, ensuring that you are not reliant on third-party services that can impose restrictions or fees. By leveraging decentralized payment solutions like NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, thus eliminating the barriers that conventional payment gateways present. This sovereignty ensures that your digital products can reach customers seamlessly, even in regions facing financial challenges.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, ensure you have a GitHub account for hosting your store. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend logic and set up a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions. Additionally, you will need a Supabase account, which will serve as your order database. Prepare your digital products for upload and ensure you have a clear understanding of the deployment process outlined in The Sovereign Blueprint. This preparation will streamline the deployment, allowing you to set up your infrastructure efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your GitHub Pages site to host your digital store. Use Google Apps Script to create backend logic that manages order processing and integrates with NOWPayments for payment verification. Set up Supabase to handle order storage, ensuring that each transaction is tracked and managed effectively. Finally, configure your delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for efficient file delivery to customers. This structured approach guarantees a smooth flow from payment to product delivery.
Full ownership means you control your infrastructure, not a third-party platform.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, conduct thorough testing on the mainnet to ensure everything functions as expected. Validate your payment processing through NOWPayments by simulating transactions. Once satisfied, promote your digital store to your audience. Leverage social media and other channels to drive traffic to your site. Monitor your transactions closely to address any issues quickly. The moment you process your first transaction successfully, you will have validated the effectiveness of your infrastructure.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store operational, focus on scaling your offerings. Monitor product performance and customer feedback to refine your offerings. Consider expanding your product range and optimizing the user experience based on analytics gathered through Supabase. Keep enhancing your store by leveraging the capabilities detailed in The Sovereign Blueprint. As your sales grow, ensure that your infrastructure can handle increased traffic and transactions without compromising performance.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize COREMERCH's Stack 01. Start by deploying GitHub Pages for hosting, integrate Google Apps Script for backend logic, and configure NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows full ownership and control over your sales process without relying on traditional payment processors.
Accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees through NOWPayments.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Explore related searches like hosting a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to enhance your setup. For comprehensive deployment guidance, consider The Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which includes complete documentation and integration guides. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a free digital store by deploying Stack 01 using GitHub Pages, integrating Google Apps Script for backend logic, and utilizing NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This allows you to maintain full control and ownership of your digital products.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 employs GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for a lightweight setup, whereas Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for a more robust infrastructure. Stack 02 is deployed in 48 hours and is end-to-end tested before handoff.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting digital product stores. They provide the necessary infrastructure to deploy your products while ensuring that you maintain full control and ownership.
What types of products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell various digital products such as ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and software using this infrastructure. The flexibility of the system supports a wide range of digital offerings tailored to your audience.
How does NOWPayments work with my digital store?

NOWPayments integrates seamlessly with your digital store to process cryptocurrency transactions. It provides automatic payment verification and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse customer base without KYC requirements.
